description: You are a Coast Guard operations officer at MRCC Falmouth (Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre) creating a Search and Rescue (SAR) training exercise for coordinating vessel response in storm conditions off the Lizard Peninsula, Cornwall. Using Bridge Command, build a complete SAR scenario from scratch and prepare all supporting documentation. Requirements: (1) Create a new scenario at '/opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/p) Lizard SAR Exercise Storm'. (2) environment.ini: Setting='Falmouth', StartTime=3.0 (0300 — SAR ops often happen at night), Weather=8.0 (storm force), Rain=5.0 (heavy rain), VisibilityRange=3.0 (reduced by rain/spray), Variation=-2.5, StartMonth=1, StartYear=2025. (3) ownship.ini: vessel 'RNLI Severn Class' (the SAR coordinator), positioned off Lizard Point at Lat=49.96, Long=-5.22, heading 045, speed 15 knots, with GPS and depth sounder enabled. (4) othership.ini: create exactly 6 vessels — (a) 'Fishing Vessel' (the casualty, drifting at 1-2 knots, near Lat=49.98, Long=-5.18), (b) 'Tanker' (commercial traffic to avoid, heading 070, speed 12 kts), (c) 'Container Ship' (heading 250, speed 14 kts), (d) 'Patrol' vessel (second SAR asset, heading toward casualty, speed 18 kts), (e) 'Yacht' (another vessel in distress / person overboard, drifting at 1 knot), (f) 'Cargo' (commercial vessel diverted to assist, heading toward casualty area, speed 10 kts). Each vessel needs 2-3 waypoint legs. (5) Configure bc5.ini: arpa_on=1, full_radar=1, radar_range_resolution=512, radar_angular_resolution=720, max_radar_range=96, hide_instruments=0. (6) Create a SAR briefing at /home/ga/Documents/sar_briefing.txt containing: incident summary, casualty description, datum point (last known position), search pattern assignment, vessel roles, communication plan (VHF channels 16 and 67), weather forecast, and safety warnings. The briefing must be at least 25 lines. Login: ga / password123.
